tickets.title: Improve DX for Installation and Usage Docs
tickets.body: Update README.md and docs/usage.md to streamline the 'how to install' and 'how to use' sections. Ensure the text flows well for new developers. Also, create docs/fumadocs-plan.md outlining a strategy to migrate all docs to Fumadocs.

tickets.title: Resolve adlc plugin via npm node_modules
tickets.body: Update `lib/bootstrap.mjs` to seamlessly install the `adlc-antigravity` plugin. Resolve `@adlc/antigravity-plugin` from `node_modules` using `require.resolve`. If it fails, fallback to the local sibling directory `../adlc/plugins/adlc-antigravity`. Add it to `dependencies` in `package.json`.

tickets.title: [P2] feat: normalize transcripts to JSONL
tickets.body:
Normalize per-ticket transcripts to JSONL and update consumers.

1. Normalize per-ticket transcripts to JSONL: one record per agy invocation `{ ts, model, strike, ms, ok, role, error, prompt, output, cwd }`. `role` is mandatory (e.g. 'builder' or 'prosecutor').
2. In `lib/agy.mjs` and `lib/prosecute.mjs`, both builder and prosecutor MUST append to `<ticketId>.jsonl` using `fs.promises.appendFile`.
3. `runAgy` should always write JSONL to `logFile` regardless of the file extension (remove the legacy write branch). `runId` is NOT passed to `runAgy` or `prosecute()`; they receive the exact `logFile` path.
4. In `lib/scheduler.mjs`, change the prosecutor log path passed to `prosecute()` from `<ticketId>.prosecution.jsonl` to `<ticketId>.jsonl`.
5. In `lib/scheduler.mjs` (`checkFlailDetector`), deserialize the JSONL transcript back to raw legacy text using the `role` field to map back correctly. Write it to a temporary file using `crypto.randomUUID()` in `os.tmpdir()` for a unique filename, pass that temp file path to `adlc flail-detector`, and then delete it.
6. Update `docs/usage.md` with semantic descriptions for all fields across `events.jsonl` and `<ticketId>.jsonl`.

Acceptance criteria:
- Transcripts parse as JSONL.
- `test/prosecute.test.mjs` expects JSONL.
- `fake-adlc` keeps working.

tickets.title: [P2] docs: remove unpublished adlc-antigravity note
tickets.body: Update README.md to remove the note claiming that @adlc/antigravity is not published to npm, as it is now published as of 1.4.1.

tickets.title: [P2] test: fix CI failure by setting git author identity in test repo
tickets.body: Configure user.name and user.email in the temporary git repository created in test/unit.test.mjs during the 'compilePlan and runPlan' test to prevent git commit failures in CI environments.

tickets.title: fix: agb doctor checkPlugin logic
tickets.body:
Fix `checkPlugin` in `lib/doctor.mjs` to correctly pass an object to `readPluginContract` (`{ dir: pluginPath }`) and check the `status` field instead of `adlcContract`.
Add missing tests to `test/doctor.test.mjs`.
